title: Account Executive
description:
About Agora

Agora is the global leader in real-time engagement, providing developers with simple, flexible, and powerful APIs to embed real-time conversational AI, voice, video, interactive live streaming, and chat into their applications and IoT devices. Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Agora is trusted by over 1,700 leading organizations across the globe to power best-in-class real-time experiences from social media and live shopping to education and telehealth.

About the role

• Agora.io’s Account Executive will be responsible for driving and gaining customer adoption of Agora.io’s technology. Reporting to our Vice President of Sales, you’ll drive sales cycles with key accounts, negotiate, and close major deals with targeted customers.

What you'll do

• Execute full lifecycle sales processes, achieving short-, mid- and long-term sales objectives and ensuring sales and revenue targets are achieved in line with corporate objectives.

• Engage potential customers, using industry standard “best practice” outbound cold sales and account management techniques, including processes calls, email, video conferences, in-person meetings, social media, referrals, etc.

• Update and maintain all sales processesincluding processes and reporting tools, including CRM, weekly sales reports, account planning etc.

• Provide account leadership and direction in the pre- and post-sales process.

• Deliver market feedback to our Executive, Product Engineering, and Product Marketing teams regarding services, features, positioning and pricing to support continuous improvement of our product offerings.

• Create adoption & drive revenue across our entire product line with an emphasis on our ConversationalAI Engine solution

Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience and success performing strategic and direct product/services technology sales; strong preference will be given to candidates coming from sales roles in a similar domain, such as WebRTC, audio/video, SDKs, and unified communications;

• Consistent ability to be directly responsible for bringing in $1,000,000+ in annual net new client revenue

• Desire and ability to adapt to, and thrive in, a startup environment and evolving industry that is rapidly changing;

• Deep analytical skills and business acumen; past success setting and achieving goals, reporting and forecasting accuracy, and consistently meeting revenue objectives;

• Compelling and influential presence in front of customers, partners and employees;

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal,. and written communication skills;

• An undergraduate degree in Business or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.

• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, up to 30% of the time.

Compensation:
Annual Base $150,000-$190,000 + commission

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Agora

Agora is the global leader in real-time engagement, providing developers with simple, flexible, and powerful APIs to embed real-time conversational AI, voice, video, interactive live streaming, and chat into their applications and IoT devices. Headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, Agora is trusted by over 5,800 leading organizations across the globe to power best-in-class real-time experiences from social media and live shopping to education and telehealth.

Product Marketing Manager – RTC & Conversational AI

Agora is looking for a sharp, strategic, hands-on Product Marketing Manager to help bring our real-time communications and Conversational AI products to market.

We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, thinks clearly, and turns complex products into compelling stories. You’ll bring strong product marketing experience, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to move from strategy to execution—from defining positioning to building the deck that helps Sales win.

You’ll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive insights, and sales enablement across our RTC and Conversational AI portfolio. Working closely with Product, Sales, Solutions Architects, Developer Relations, Growth, and Field Marketing, you’ll help customers understand what Agora makes possible, why it matters, and why they should choose us.

Prior developer marketing experience is helpful, but not required. Intellectual curiosity, strong PMM fundamentals, and the ability to build credibility in a technical market matter more.

What You’ll Do

• Own positioning and messaging. Define clear value propositions, differentiated narratives, and customer stories for Agora’s RTC and Conversational AI products.

• Lead product launches. Build and execute GTM plans for new products, features, and solutions, including target audiences, launch objectives, channel strategy, and pricing and packaging recommendations.

• Create content that helps us win. Develop pitch decks, solution briefs, customer stories, demo narratives, sales playbooks, battlecards, FAQs, and launch materials.

• Enable Sales and partners. Give GTM teams the product knowledge, competitive context, and practical tools they need to engage customers and close business. Lead live enablement sessions and refine materials based on field feedback.

• Turn research into decisions. Understand customer needs, buying behavior, market trends, and competitors. Translate findings into recommendations for Product, Marketing, and Sales.

• Connect product strategy to market needs. Partner with Product Management to inform roadmap discussions and translate technical capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes.

• Strengthen messaging across channels. Work with Growth and Field Marketing to bring a consistent, compelling story to the website, campaigns, events, webinars, and content programs.

• Measure and improve impact. Evaluate launch performance, pipeline and revenue influence, content usage, and win/loss patterns to sharpen our approach.

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of product marketing experience, with a track record of owning positioning, messaging, launches, and sales enablement for B2B products.

• Experience in a rigorous product marketing organization, at a company known for strong talent, high standards, and successful products. You can point to work you personally owned and explain its impact.

• A strong academic record and demonstrated analytical ability. You learn unfamiliar subjects quickly, ask incisive questions, and synthesize complex information into clear recommendations.

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills. You can turn product capabilities and customer insights into a persuasive narrative—and create polished content yourself.

• Strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You can frame a market opportunity, make choices about where to focus, and deliver the materials and programs needed to act on those choices.

• Technical curiosity. You’re comfortable learning how products work and translating that understanding into customer value. You don’t need to be an engineer or have marketed to developers before.

• Strong cross-functional judgment. You build productive relationships with Product and Sales, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and keep work moving across teams.

• Ownership and adaptability. You’re a resourceful self-starter who finds answers independently, navigates ambiguity, manages competing priorities, and delivers high-quality work in a fast-moving, global environment.

Helpful Experience

• Product marketing in B2B SaaS, cloud, AI, infrastructure, communications, or other technical categories

• Familiarity with Conversational AI, real-time voice and video, APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms

• Experience marketing to technical buyers, product leaders, or enterprise decision-makers

• Experience partnering with demand generation, growth, or field marketing on integrated GTM programs

• Thoughtful use of AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, and content development while maintaining accuracy and quality

You don’t need experience in every part of our market. We’re looking for a strong product marketer with the intellectual range, curiosity, and drive to learn it.

Work Location

This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office. The role requires in-office presence three days per week, generally Tuesday through Thursday.

title: Field Product & Developer Evangelist- HQ, Santa Clara
description:
About Agora

Agora (NASDAQ: API) helps people connect- with each other and with AI- in real time. As AI becomes part of everyday life, conversations with it need to feel as natural and immediate as talking to another person. Making that work everywhere, for everyone, takes more than intelligent AI. It takes infrastructure built for real-time conversation at a global scale. That’s where we come in.

We give developers the APIs and no-code tools to bring conversational AI, voice, video, live streaming, and chat to applications and connected devices- from social platforms and virtual classrooms to AI assistants and embedded agents. Based in Santa Clara, California, we’ve reached more than 450,000 developers, and our technology is embedded in over 3 billion devices. Every month, 80 billion minutes of audio and video run through our carrier-grade network.

Join us to help build what comes next: a world where people and AI can connect, communicate, and take action together- from anywhere, on any device.

Field Product & Developer Evangelist

Location: San Francisco/Santa Clara, CA

Role Overview

We’re looking for a passionate Field Product & Developer Evangelist who thrives at the intersection of technology, community, and storytelling. This role blends deep product understanding with a public-facing presence. You’ll represent Agora at key AI, developer, and product events; translate developer and market feedback into product insight; and act as a bridge between our Product, Engineering, and Developer Ecosystem teams.

The ideal candidate is equal parts technical communicator, product strategist, and community builder — someone who can inspire developers while shaping the roadmap with real-world insight.

Key Responsibilities

Field Product Engagement

·       Act as a product expert for Agora’s Conversational AI and real-time engagement solutions in the field.

·       Lead technical demos, workshops, and proof-of-concept sessions with customers, developers, and partners.

·       Translate customer use cases and field insights into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

·       Partner with the Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success teams to support adoption and product alignment.

·       Identify market opportunities and help shape go-to-market strategies for new releases and SDKs.

Developer Evangelism & Advocacy

·       Represent Agora at global and regional AI and developer conferences, meetups, and industry events.

·       Deliver keynotes, technical talks, and hands-on workshops that highlight Agora’s platform capabilities.

·       Build and nurture relationships with developers, open-source contributors, and ecosystem partners.

·       Create high-impact content (tutorials, blogs, code samples, videos) to educate and inspire the developer community.

·       Foster authentic engagement through online channels (GitHub, Discord, X, LinkedIn, and community forums).

Cross-Functional Partnership

·       Collaborate with Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and launch readiness.

·       Provide structured feedback to Product Managers and Engineering on market trends and developer sentiment.

·       Partner with Developer Relations to amplify ecosystem initiatives, hackathons, and strategic partnerships.

Qualifications

·       5–7 years of experience in product, developer advocacy, or technical field roles within SaaS, AI, or infrastructure technology.

·       Hands-on experience with APIs, SDKs, or AI/ML frameworks (Python, Node.js, or similar).

·       Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences in the local language and English.

·       Comfortable presenting at conferences and engaging on social channels or public forums.

·       Strong understanding of the developer ecosystem, open-source culture, and community-driven growth.

·       Passion for AI, real-time engagement, and the future of human-machine interaction.

·       Willingness to travel (25–40%) for events, customer visits, and field engagements.

Preferred Attributes

·       Experience in conversational AI, voice/video APIs, or developer platform companies (e.g., Twilio, OpenAI, Hugging Face).

·       Previous success in building or scaling a developer community.

·       A creative storyteller who can connect business impact to technical depth.

·       Self-starter comfortable working across global, fast-moving teams.

title: Senior Social Media Manager
locations: Centennial, CO; Santa Clara, CA; New York, NY
description:
About Agora

Agora (NASDAQ: API) is building the technology behind a more connected world—where people connect with each other and interact naturally with AI. A global leader in real-time engagement, Agora gives developers the APIs and no-code tools to bring conversational AI, voice, video, live streaming, and chat to applications and connected devices.

Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Agora has reached more than 450,000 developers, with its technology embedded in over 3 billion devices. Each month, 80 billion minutes of audio and video run through Agora’s carrier-grade network, powering experiences spanning social platforms, live shopping, education, healthcare, and customer service. Join us to help shape how the world connects, communicates, and interacts with AI.

About the role

Own the Voice. Build the Community. Drive the Conversation.

At Agora, we're powering the next generation of real-time digital experiences. We're looking for a strategic, creative, and technically savvy Senior Social Media Manager to lead our global social media strategy, grow our audiences, and drive meaningful engagement.

This isn't your traditional social media role. As a developer-first company, our conversations extend beyond LinkedIn to where developers build, collaborate, and innovate — Reddit, X, GitHub, YouTube, and Discord.

You'll own both strategy and hands-on execution, creating a consistent, recognizable Agora voice while tailoring content to each platform and audience. You'll lead global editorial planning, coordinate across regions, engage directly with developer communities, and amplify product launches, technical content, and industry partnerships.

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional editorial judgment, social media expertise, technical fluency, and a data-driven growth mindset. You'll leverage platform insights and algorithms to optimize performance, expand our reach, and turn engagement into measurable impact.

Working closely with Marketing, DevX, DevRel, Product, Engineering, Communications, and executive leadership, you'll bring consistency, creativity, and direction to Agora's global social presence.

If you know how to turn social media into a powerful engine for community, influence, and growth, we want to meet you.

What you'll do

Own Global Social Strategy & Performance

• Develop and execute Agora's global social media strategy across Reddit, X, GitHub, YouTube, Discord, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

• Define channel-specific audiences, content strategies, engagement approaches, growth targets, and performance metrics.

• Drive measurable growth in followers, subscribers, reach, engagement, and brand visibility across Agora's core social channels.

• Establish a consistent global brand voice while tailoring content and participation to each platform's culture and audience.

• Evaluate emerging platforms, content formats, and industry trends to identify opportunities for audience development.

Drive Developer-First Social Engagement

• Establish Agora as an active, credible voice across developer-focused social channels rather than simply a publisher of marketing content.

• Monitor technical discussions and identify opportunities to contribute meaningful perspectives, answer questions, and engage with developers and industry experts.

• Develop platform-native content that resonates with technical audiences and encourages authentic conversation and participation.

• Translate sophisticated technical topics into compelling social content without sacrificing accuracy or credibility.

• Partner with DevRel and DevX to align social activity with developer programs and initiatives, while respecting DevRel's ownership of developer communities.

Lead Editorial & Thought Leadership

• Own and manage an integrated global social editorial calendar spanning product launches, technical education, thought leadership, customer stories, events, research, and corporate communications.

• Coordinate social campaigns and editorial priorities across regions, ensuring consistent messaging, timing, and execution.

• Develop and execute social amplification strategies for technical blogs, webinars, conferences, videos, product announcements, and other marketing content.

• Partner with executives and technical leaders to develop thought leadership content that strengthens Agora's presence across developer and enterprise audiences.

• Transform long-form editorial and technical content into channel-native posts, threads, short-form videos, technical explainers, and other social formats.

• Work closely with Content Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications, DevRel, Product, and Engineering to ensure a synchronized editorial strategy.

Manage Active Social Engagement

• Establish a consistent operating rhythm for monitoring and engaging across Agora's global social channels.

• Respond to relevant questions, discussions, product feedback, and industry conversations in coordination with appropriate internal teams.

• Develop escalation processes for technical questions, customer issues, product feedback, and reputational concerns.

• Identify influential developers, creators, partners, and industry voices and cultivate relevant social relationships.

• Surface recurring developer, customer, competitive, and industry insights to inform messaging, editorial priorities, and broader marketing strategy.

Support Employee Advocacy & Internal Engagement

• Encourage executives, product managers, engineers, developer advocates, and other subject matter experts to participate in relevant social conversations.

• Provide content suggestions, editorial guidance, and lightweight tools that make it easier for employees to share their expertise.

• Coordinate internal participation around major launches, technical announcements, events, and thought leadership initiatives.

• Work with functional leaders to recognize and encourage meaningful employee participation.

Measure Performance & Optimize

• Establish channel-specific goals, dashboards, and reporting to evaluate global social media performance.

• Track engagement rates, meaningful interactions, follower and subscriber growth, reach, impressions, and audience development.

• Measure platform-specific performance, including YouTube views and watch time, Reddit and X engagement, GitHub visibility, and LinkedIn audience growth.

• Evaluate thought leadership performance, brand mentions, share of conversation, referral traffic, and social amplification of editorial content.

• Use quantitative performance data and qualitative audience insights to continuously improve channel strategy, content effectiveness, and engagement.

• Communicate results, insights, and recommendations to Marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in social media, developer marketing, technical marketing, content marketing, or a related discipline within a developer platform, enterprise technology, AI, cloud, or infrastructure technology company.

• Demonstrated success growing and managing social media programs for technical or developer audiences, ideally across multiple geographic regions.

• Deep familiarity with Reddit, X, GitHub, YouTube, Discord, and LinkedIn, including the different norms and expectations of each platform.

• Proven ability to drive measurable audience growth, engagement, and content performance.

• Strong understanding of how developers consume content, evaluate technical claims, and engage with technology companies online.

• Exceptional writing, editing, and editorial judgment, with the ability to adapt messaging for technical and business audiences.

• Technical fluency sufficient to understand and communicate concepts involving APIs, SDKs, real-time communications, Conversational AI, voice AI, and developer platforms.

• Experience working with product managers, engineers, developer advocates, executives, and marketers to translate technical expertise into compelling social content.

• Strong instincts around authentic engagement, technical storytelling, and thought leadership.

• Experience managing global editorial calendars and coordinating programs across teams, regions, and time zones.

• Strong analytical skills and experience using performance data to optimize social strategy and demonstrate measurable results.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Work arrangement. This role requires a hybrid schedule, with time split between the office and remote work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means Agora develops a consistent, credible, and influential global social media presence that drives sustained audience growth, meaningful engagement, and greater brand visibility.

Agora's developer-first channels become active destinations for relevant technical content and conversations, while corporate channels effectively communicate our innovation, customer success, and industry leadership.

Our global editorial programs operate in a coordinated manner, and social media becomes an increasingly effective channel for amplifying Agora's products, technical expertise, thought leadership, and marketing initiatives.

Ultimately, this role strengthens Agora's position as a leading voice in real-time communications and Conversational AI through measurable social media performance and authentic engagement with the audiences that matter most.
